title: Hearing on senior centers located at NYCHA housing
summary: The Council's Aging and Public Housing Committees held a joint oversight hearing on older adult centers at NYCHA facilities, examining repair delays, unclear responsibility between DFTA and NYCHA, and the effects of the PACT privatization program on these centers. As of 2025, 109 of the city's 317 older adult centers were located on NYCHA property, serving about 7,227 people daily. The Committees also considered a bill requiring DFTA to place a financial literacy advisor in every older adult center for at least 20 hours a month.
